post.description:
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header per user action: a repeated request (double submit,
network retry) returns the run the first one created instead of starting another.

Stops a run. A running graph notices before its next LLM or tool call. Drafts it already
created stay as drafts.
Apply the user's approve / edit / reject decisions and let the run finish.

get.description:
Replays the run's events, then follows live ones. Event types are documented in the
README. Ends after `run_finished`, or when the run is over and nothing new arrives.

post.description:
Streams progress as SSE: `step`, `variant`, `item`, then `done` or `error`.

With an `Idempotency-Key` header, a repeat of the same request (double submit, network or
proxy retry) doesn't generate again: it waits for the original and streams its saved items.
